capabilities: Insert media cards using a media-card code block
Configure card fields (type, title, cover, url, introduction) in YAML
Render custom key-value fields with HTML and links on cards
Use vault paths or web URLs for cover images
disambiguation: It does not fetch media information from Douban or any service; users enter all card content manually in YAML.
extras: Card types are currently limited to movie, music, and book; detailed YAML parameters are documented externally under 'Parameters'.
intentEvidence: This project was inspired by hexo-douban-card and references the design and implementation of the card style.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render styled cards for media items like books, music, or movies inside a note.

relations.evidence: This project was inspired by hexo-douban-card and references the design and implementation of the card style.
This Obsidian plugin is a wrapper for the Remark Media Card.

summary: Plugin that inserts media information cards (movies, music, books) into notes via a custom markdown code block configured with YAML.
